fact: Enabel's PAIOSA programme, supporting the Burundian agricultural sector with Belgian and Burundian governments, began satellite crop monitoring (EOSDA, NDVI and other indices twice weekly at 10 m) of 4,500 hectares of smallholder farmland in November 2021; run by a Belgian agency with a vendor, not a Burundian service alone.
title: Enabel Integrates Sat And Drone Data To Boost Agriculture
